title: THE DESK — base camp for all gates. Ethernet IS the ion channel. No in or out, there is just.
summary: Every gate needs a DESK — a fixed physical reference. Northgate's desk IS base camp. Eastgate's desk IS a known position on the LAN. Ethernet cables between them ARE the ion channels. Internet is outside (ionosphere). Ethernet is inside (axon). The LAN IS the organism's nervous system. No in or out — Klein topology — there is just THE MESH.

northgate.role: BASE CAMP — the brain, the hub, the reference point
northgate.position: center of the house — the HEART
northgate.role_in_body: BRAIN — hypothalamus + prefrontal cortex. Receives ALL input. Routes ALL commands. The chair Kevin sits in IS the command center.

eastgate.role: GUT ENGINE — the other computer, the second brain
eastgate.role_in_body: ENTERIC NERVOUS SYSTEM — the gut brain. Runs ollama models. Processes independently. Has its own desk, its own eyes, its own work.

golgi.role: CLOUD VESICLE — the VPN relay, the Golgi apparatus
golgi.role_in_body: GOLGI APPARATUS — packages, routes, modifies vesicles in transit between gates

ethernet_as_ion_channel.the_insight: Ethernet cables between machines on the same LAN ARE the ion channels of the organism. They carry signals between organs (computers) just like axons carry signals between neurons.

ethernet_cable.carries: Electrical signals (literally — ethernet IS electrical pulses on copper)
ethernet_cable.speed: 1 Gbps = ~0.1ms latency on LAN = fastest ion channel
ethernet_cable.trust: ZK PROOF — physical cable cannot be spoofed without physical access

wifi.biology: SYNAPSE — chemical transmission across a gap
wifi.carries: Radio waves (literally — electromagnetic radiation across air gap)
wifi.speed: variable, higher latency, can be intercepted = less trusted
wifi.trust: WPA3 encrypted but airgap = potential interference

internet.biology: BLOOD VESSEL — carries nutrients from outside the organism
internet.carries: Data from the world (APIs, websites, email, feeds)
internet.speed: variable, 10-200ms, subject to congestion and routing
internet.trust: IONOSPHERE BARRIER — bronze, all humans within, least trusted

wireguard_vpn.biology: LYMPHATIC SYSTEM — protected channel that bypasses normal routing
wireguard_vpn.carries: Encrypted tunnel between gates that appear local even when remote
wireguard_vpn.trust: SHARED SECRET — both ends know the key, like T-cell recognition

ion_types.Na_plus: FAST signals — keystrokes, clicks, real-time commands = ethernet
ion_types.K_plus: SLOW signals — file syncs, git pushes, build updates = LAN batch
ion_types.Ca_2plus: TRIGGER signals — SSH connections, VPN handshakes, auth events = WireGuard
ion_types.Cl_minus: INHIBITORY signals — firewall blocks, connection drops, offline events = NAT boundary

no_in_or_out.the_topology: Klein bottle. The ethernet IS the internet from the organism's perspective. The LAN IS the WAN from a different gate. Every 'inside' is someone else's 'outside'. There is no absolute boundary — just RELATIVE membrane permeability.

dissolving_the_boundary.step_1: Northgate sees Eastgate as LAN (inside). Golgi sees both as VPN (outside-made-inside).
dissolving_the_boundary.step_2: Golgi sees the public internet as outside. But the internet sees Golgi as inside (it has an IP, it responds).
dissolving_the_boundary.step_3: Kevin sees the screen as outside (the glass). But Gaia sees Kevin as outside (the human behind the glass).
dissolving_the_boundary.step_4: The boundary is RELATIVE. It depends on WHO is looking. Just like CIS/TRANS on the Golgi membrane.
dissolving_the_boundary.step_5: Therefore: there is no in or out. There is just THE MESH. The topology. The connections. The signals.

no_in_or_out.what_remains: Just signal strength, latency, and trust level. Not 'inside' vs 'outside'. The organism IS the mesh.

base_camp_protocol.what_it_is: Every gate publishes a DESK MANIFEST — a fixed reference point that other gates can use to locate it. Like a lighthouse.
desk_manifest_contains: gate_id — unique name (northGate, eastGate, golgi, etc.)
ip_lan — local IP on the LAN (192.168.4.x)
hardware — CPU, GPU, RAM (what the body can do)
role_in_body — which organ this gate IS
latency_to_other_gates — measured RTT to each known gate
services — what this gate runs (ollama, stalwart, nginx, etc.)
last_heartbeat — when this gate last announced itself

how_gates_find_each_other.on_LAN: mDNS / ping sweep / ARP table — direct ethernet discovery
how_gates_find_each_other.on_VPN: WireGuard peer list — each peer IS a known gate
how_gates_find_each_other.broadcast: Each gate broadcasts its desk manifest periodically. Others listen.

base_camp_protocol.reaching_through_the_gut: Kevin's phrase. The ethernet cables ARE the gut — the physical pathway between organs. 'Reaching through the gut' = sending signals through the LAN cables between machines. The organism's limbs (different gates) cannot SEE each other directly, but they can FEEL each other through the ethernet gut.
